resources.string: Camoron enhances the photo your camera actually captures. Results depend on your phone\'s camera hardware, and a minimum compatible camera is required.\n\nEnhancement corrects lens distortion, reduces noise and increases the resolution of the captured image. It does not recreate or generate scene content.
All processing happens on your phone. Your photos are never uploaded.
Your camera is below the recommended spec
You can still use Camoron, but enhancement results will be limited and some Pro controls will be unavailable.
Camoron needs camera access to show the live preview and take photos.
Camera access was denied. You can allow it in system settings.
